checks.explanation: Dean Phillips never came close to defeating Biden for the nomination while Biden remained in the race, consistent with the prediction, before Biden ultimately withdrew for unrelated reasons in July 2024.

Dean Phillips' campaign did not gain traction; he received only about 19.6% of the vote in the New Hampshire primary against a write-in Biden campaign and dropped out of the race in March 2024 without ever polling competitively.

Biden did not remain in the 2024 race; he withdrew as the Democratic nominee in July 2024 amid pressure following his poor debate performance, contradicting the predicted 70% probability of staying in.
US CPI inflation was running around 3.1-3.2% year-over-year in February and March 2024, not in the predicted low-2% range.
